name: Gondwana & Divine Clothing Co.
old_description: Embrace the serene charm of this polka dot wine sweater, thoughtfully designed for an etherial vibe. With elbow length balloon sleeves and a classic mock neckline, this sweater exudes a relaxed yet fashionable aura. Refresh your wardrobe with this adorable piece!
about:
Gondwana & Divine Clothing Co. operates a women's apparel boutique in Concord, New Hampshire. The business maintains an e-commerce site at gondwanaclothing.com and a physical storefront where it sells a range of knitwear, dresses, outerwear, and accessories. No founding year, founder names, or ownership structure are disclosed in the available information.

The retailer stocks merchandise from several established brands, including Clara Sunwoo, Habitat, Salaam, Free People, and Desigual. Inventory covers sweaters, sweater jackets, tunics, cardigans, dresses, and faux-fur hats and beanies. One cardigan is described as 38% Merino wool, 38% acrylic, and 24% nylon with a hidden zipper pocket detail. The company does not perform manufacturing; it purchases finished goods for resale.

The customer base consists of individual shoppers looking for women's fashion in a variety of sizes. Testimonials on the site note that the assortment accommodates different body shapes and style preferences. The store offers free standard shipping on orders exceeding $150.

Shoppers repeatedly cite the knowledge and friendliness of the sales staff as a primary reason for loyalty. Reviews describe the team as helpful and dedicated to ensuring customers feel confident in their purchases. The company highlights these testimonials on its homepage.
